shields.name: William Scott Shields
shields.biography: William Scott Shields was the Natural Law Party candidate for lieutenant governor of Utah on the 1996 ticket with Robert C. Lesh. The official canvass abbreviates this ticket as “Lesh & Shields”; contemporary Utah reporting supplies his full name. The canvass reports 2,969 votes for the joint ticket.

resources.label: Official 1996 election result — Lesh & Shields
resources.description: The Utah general-election canvass lists 2,969 votes for the joint Natural Law governor/lieutenant-governor ticket.
